stories.h: Seattle budget clears committee 7-2, final vote today
stories.s: The council's budget committee advanced the 2027-28 budget, which closes a $175M deficit and cuts dozens of jobs. Rivera voted no. The full council is set to vote Friday at 1 p.m.

stories.h: Redmond removes all 24 Flock license plate cameras
stories.s: Redmond says all of its Flock plate-reader cameras are gone after the council ended the contract over privacy concerns. The city says no federal or out-of-state agency received its data.

stories.h: Driver charged in 119-mph fatal I-5 SeaTac crash
stories.s: A 23-year-old faces vehicular homicide and five vehicular assault counts after investigators say he was racing at 119 mph before a seven-car crash that killed a 68-year-old man. The other driver is still sought.

stories.h: Maritime High students walk out over proposed closure
stories.s: Students protested at Highline Public Schools' offices against closing Maritime High in Des Moines, which the district says would save $2.1M a year. A hearing is Dec. 2; the board votes Dec. 9.

stories.h: Suspect in Shoreline deputy stabbing arrested in Texas
stories.s: U.S. Marshals arrested a 35-year-old man in El Paso. He faces charges in the stabbing of a King County deputy in Shoreline and had been out on $25,000 bail.

coming.h: Thanksgiving travel crunch on highways and ferries
coming.s: WSDOT expects the busiest westbound ferry sailings Nov. 25–26 and eastbound Nov. 28–29, and urges reservations. Most highway construction pauses for the holiday.

coming.h: Westlake tree lighting and holiday carousel return
coming.s: Festivities in Westlake Park start at 11 a.m.; the tree is lit at 5 p.m. with fireworks. The carousel runs through Jan. 3.
